Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

N=27
grid=[[4]*N for _ in range(N)]
for j in range(N): grid[13][j]=1; grid[j][13]=1
# Top-left template
for r,c in [(3,6),(4,6)]: grid[r][c]=7
grid[4][5]=8
for r in [5,6]:
    grid[r][4]=9
    for c in [5,6]: grid[r][c]=2
    for c in [7,8]: grid[r][c]=1
# Other solid 2 anchors
for r in [5,6]:
    for c in [20,21]: grid[r][c]=2
for r in range(19,23):
    for c in range(4,8): grid[r][c]=2
for r in [20,21]:
    for c in [19,20]: grid[r][c]=2
# Template decorations as source-pixel coordinates, source seed starts at (5,5), size 2
marks={7:[(3,6),(4,6)],8:[(4,5)],9:[(5,4),(6,4)],1:[(r,c) for r in [5,6] for c in [7,8]]}
def transfer(r0,c0,d,flipx=False,flipy=False):
    scale=d//2
    for color,coords in marks.items():
        for sr,sc in coords:
            jr,jc=sr-5,sc-5
            # block start offsets; reflecting around the target anchor block
            roff=(d - (jr+1)*scale) if flipy else jr*scale
            coff=(d - (jc+1)*scale) if flipx else jc*scale
            for dr in range(scale):
                for dc in range(scale):
                    rr=r0+roff+dr; cc=c0+coff+dc
                    if not (0<=rr<27 and 0<=cc<27): print('out of bounds',color,rr,cc)
                    grid[rr][cc]=color
# top-right horizontal reflection, bottom-left vertical reflection, bottom-right both
transfer(5,20,2,flipx=True)
transfer(19,4,4,flipy=True)
transfer(20,19,2,flipx=True,flipy=True)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
